title: Pip and the Rainbow Paint Splash
moral: Telling the truth makes our hearts feel light and happy.
description: It's Rainbow Day, and Nana Hoot has seven pots of paint for a giant rainbow! But Pip can't wait, and one super-duper spin later there's a big blue SPLOOSH. Learn red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet in this funny animated story about honesty for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Guess what, friends? Today was Rainbow Day in Clover Meadow!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! Let's paint a great big rainbow on my garden wall. I have seven pots of paint!
Seven! Let's count the pots together. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet. The colours of the rainbow!
Can you say them with Nana? Red... orange... yellow...

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: I can say them too! Red, orange, yellow, green, blue... in-DINO and vi-o-LIN!
Hee hee! Not a dinosaur, Pip, and not a violin! It's INDIGO and VIOLET!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Now, keep an eye on the paint while I fetch the brushes. Back in a jiffy!
So Tumble put his eye right up close to the paint pot. Like THIS! HONK!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: I'm keeping an eye on it, Nana! Oopsie-trunk... it's very wet!

narration.text: But Pip did NOT want to wait. Not one teeny bit!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: I'll start! My fluffy tail can be the paintbrush. Super-duper!
Swish! A wiggly RED stripe. Swish, swish! A wobbly orange stripe!
SPLAT! Orange paint flew everywhere. Look at Mister Snail on the wall. What colour is his shell now?
ORANGE! You're so smart! Mister Snail looks very surprised.

narration.text: Then Pip tried his fanciest swish of all. A super-duper SPIN!
Zip, zip, zip! Round and round and round... KA-BONK! Right into the washing line pole!
The blue paint pot flipped up high... and SPLOOSH! It landed on Nana's best violet blanket!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Uh-oh, Pip! Now it's violet with BLUE spots!
Pip's tummy felt all wiggly and jiggly. He stuffed the blanket into a bucket. Quick, quick, quick!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Shhh! Maybe Nana won't notice!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: But Pip... hiding things makes my trunk feel nervous.
Tumble tried to whistle like nothing happened. But his trunk went TOOT! HONK! PFFFT!
Hmm. Is hiding it a good idea? Pip didn't think so either.

narration.text: Then Nana Hoot came back with the brushes. Her glasses slid down, down, down her beak.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Here I am! Now... where is my violet blanket? Zzzz... I'm awake!
Pip looked at the bucket. He took a big, brave breath.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Nana... it was me. I spun around and spilled blue paint on your blanket. Then I hid it. I'm really sorry.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Oh, Pip. Thank you for telling me the truth. That makes my heart so happy. Let's fix it together!

narration.text: Down at the stream, they washed the blanket. Splish, splash, scrub, scrub, scrub!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: I can help! I'll give it a big trunk shower!
WHOOSH! Tumble sprayed the blanket... and Nana too! SPLOOSH!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo! I'm awake! I'm AWAKE! Hoo-hoo-HOO!
Most of the blue washed away. The last little spots looked like tiny blue stars.

narration.text: Later, ALL together, they painted the rainbow. One colour at a time!
Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet! Seven beautiful stripes!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: It smells so painty... AH... AH... AH-CHOOOO!
Uh-oh! Tiny paint dots sprinkled everywhere. Now it's a polka-dot rainbow!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Super-duper! It's the best rainbow EVER!

narration.text: That evening, by the cosy fire... Let's remember! How many colours are in a rainbow?
SEVEN! Great job!
And which colour is at the very top of the rainbow?

narration.text: That night, Nana's violet blanket sat on the garden bench, with little blue star spots.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: I love it even more now. And I love that you told the truth, Pip.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Telling the truth made my wiggly tummy feel light as a feather!
And Tumble? He fell fast asleep... still keeping an eye on the paint! Hee hee!
